_comment: MemPalace stdio MCP server — 1:1 with the fork's DefaultMCPServers() spec. gc projects project-scoped MCP servers when the session settings carry enableAllProjectMcpServers=true (the pilot city's .gc/settings.json already sets this). The command must be the ABSOLUTE resolved venv python; adjust the path per host, or template it if gc supports {{.Home}}/{{.CityRoot}} substitution in overlay files (UNVERIFIED — see README). If the venv is absent the fork omits this server entirely; a stdio server pointing at a missing binary simply fails to start (harmless), matching the graceful-degradation intent.
